headline: ATL @ BOS matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is ATL 3.56 at BOS 2.22, with a projected total of 5.78. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward ATL: ATL moved -0.90 runs while BOS moved -1.53, changing the projected margin by +0.63 runs. The projected total fell -2.42, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +22.1%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Chris Sale has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Willson Contreras, Jarren Duran, Nick Sogard, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Ha-Seong Kim because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
